cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: What Are We Now?
cards.instruction: Find out how someone defines the relationship without directly asking for a label.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. For your sister's wedding, should I book us one room or two?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Double bed, then, or shall I ask for twins?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Twins. I don't want to confuse things.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Right. At breakfast, do I sit with your family or wait for you in the lobby?
